description:
Virtual queue for hot on-sales with fair ordering, purchase limits (per customer account / per event), rate limiting and suspicious-order flagging.

**Conditions of Success:**
- Queue admits fairly (no line-jumping) and meters load into checkout
- Purchase limits enforce at checkout across guest/account identities
- Abuse signals flag orders for staff review without blocking legitimate buyers

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map).

**Amended (grilling):** Design-target on-sale (owner NFR): ~50-100k capacity event, 100k+ concurrent buyers in the waiting room, thousands of checkout attempts/min sustained. Purchase-limit identity: limits key on customer accounts; events with strict limits can require login (guest checkout stays available elsewhere). Card/device fingerprinting NOT in v1.

**Amended (owner directive 2026-07-12):** bot detection/prevention must NOT blanket-block non-human traffic — LLM agents are legitimate buyers (TKT-40). Countermeasures target scalper automation; declared, limit-abiding agents get a defined lane through queue and checkout. Every blocking mechanism in this epic must state how it treats declared agents.

**Amended (owner algorithm + review, 2026-07-12):** Waiting-room algorithm settled — lottery-ordered pre-queue with range-sliced admission, from the owner's previous platform, refined in review:
- **Pre-sale waiting room requires login.** Each user gets a lottery position in a large number space (uniform random order = fair draw; join time before on-sale gives no advantage, so no thundering herd at waitlist open).
- **Derive the position, don't store it:** `position = PRF(event_key, user_id)` (e.g. HMAC truncated to the space) instead of the original assign-random-number-then-encrypt. Same uniform distribution, but deterministic (lost token re-derivable on any device), storage-free at assignment, and one draw per account by construction. If admission tokens are the source of truth they must be authenticated, not just encrypted — AEAD with user ID + event ID bound in, else ciphertext malleability lets attackers hunt low positions. One key per event (limits blast radius); a leaked key mints position 0, so key handling is on-sale-critical; keys from a CSPRNG.
- **Collisions in the space are expected (birthday at 100k users) and harmless** for range-sliced admission — ties enter in the same window. Positions shown to users are approximate; nothing downstream (support tooling, disputes) may treat them as unique.
- **Admission = sliding window over the number space.** N frozen at sale start, so per-slice counts give position + ETA. The window must be **drain-rate-driven, not wall-clock**: advance on observed admissions and completed/abandoned checkouts (expect 20-40% no-shows at hot on-sales), throttle on checkout health, recompute ETAs continuously from actual drain rate.
- **Post-start arrivals:** instead of a separate FIFO drained only after the waitlist (unbounded ETA for late joiners), map them into the tail of the same number space (MAX + monotonic counter, or a second PRF band) — one window, one ETA model, one thing to load-test.
- **Lottery ordering sharpens the Sybil incentive** (more accounts = more draws, linear payoff): abuse/dedup controls must bite at draw time, not checkout, or the queue is already lost. Coordinate with TKT-40's declared-agent lane; v1 constraint stands (account-level controls only, no card/device fingerprinting).
- **Admission is not a bearer right:** bind admitted state to the authenticated session, single-use. Spec must also pin: behavior on session expiry after admission (re-window vs tail vs drop), and sell-out-before-drain comms (ETA carries an inventory-likelihood signal past a threshold).

comments.body: COS defined at epic level. Not yet decomposed — US-stories are created when the owner prioritizes this epic (Gate 1), per PRD 'Capability map'.
Backlog grilling 2026-07-12 (owner decisions): festival-scale NFR quantified; limit identity = account-required for strict-limit events.

Final review fix: original description still said limits keyed 'per customer/card/event', contradicting the grilling amendment (account-keyed, no card/device fingerprinting in v1). Original text corrected.

Owner directive pre-commit: SEO/GEO/agent-first is a must (new epic TKT-40). Constraint added here: no blanket bot-blocking — distinguish scalper automation from legitimate agents; the balance policy is co-owned with TKT-40.

2026-07-12: owner supplied the waiting-list algorithm from their previous platform (login-gated pre-sale room, random number 0..MAX_INT encrypted with a per-event reversible key, sliced number space for rate-metered admission + approximate position/ETA, sliding window, plain FIFO for post-start arrivals drained after the waitlist). Reviewed and amended into the description with four refinements: (1) keyed PRF of user_id replaces assign-random-then-encrypt (deterministic, storage-free, one draw per account; AEAD if tokens are the admission source of truth); (2) sliding window driven by observed drain rate instead of wall-clock schedule (no-shows, checkout health); (3) post-start arrivals mapped into the tail of the same number space instead of a separate FIFO phase; (4) Sybil/dedup controls applied at draw time, coordinated with TKT-40. Architecture (lottery pre-queue + range-sliced admission) is settled — do not re-derive when the epic is picked up.
